Name: Vanilla-Style Lucien Portraits
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I like my characters to all be done in a vanilla style so I've been utilizing Poltergeister & Jazzybee's [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdv-creator-masc]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url] to give some custom NPCs a makeover! I decided to share the ones that have open permissions or I've been given permission for in case you're OCD like me.

This one was a request to make a vanilla-esque portrait for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49754]Lucien the Werewolf[/url] by K1N0K0SSUP3RGAY, who left permissions open for portraits. Just download, drag and drop over the original mod, and let it overwrite! *Note: These portraits do NOT need portraiture like the original ones do.

Enjoy!
